title: Skid buffer (valid/ready)
spec: A skid buffer that passes WIDTH-bit words from an upstream valid/ready interface (in_valid, in_data, in_ready) to a downstream one (out_valid, out_data, out_ready), with one rising-edge clock clk. It holds at most two words.
rst is a synchronous active-high reset: at a rising edge with rst high the buffer becomes empty and nothing is accepted or delivered at that edge.

At each rising edge without reset, a word is accepted when in_valid and in_ready are both high, and the word on out_data is delivered when out_valid and out_ready are both high. Both can happen at the same edge.

in_ready is high exactly when the buffer holds fewer than two words. out_valid is high exactly when the buffer holds at least one word, and out_data is then the oldest word held. in_ready, out_valid, and out_data depend only on the buffer's contents, never directly on the inputs in the same cycle.

Words are delivered in the order they were accepted, each exactly once, with nothing lost or duplicated. While out_valid is high and out_ready is low, out_valid stays high and out_data stays the same. out_data is only meaningful while out_valid is high.
